chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Washing the head with al-khiṭmī removes poverty and increases sustenance."
ai.seo_question: How does washing the head with al-khiṭmī affect poverty and sustenance according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that washing the head with al-khiṭmī is a means by which poverty is repelled and sustenance is increased. It reflects teachings on cleanliness and beneficial practices associated with blessing in one's livelihood.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.291 – (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) ) states:
"Washing the head with Al-khatmi (a type of herbal shampoo or marshmallow root) removes poverty and increases sustenance."
